I’m sorry you’re feeling this way. I’ll ask a few focused questions to narrow down the cause.

**Question 1 (one at a time):**  
When did the shortness of breath start—**suddenly (minutes to hours)** or **gradually (over days)**?
I don't know.

No problem.

**Question 2:** Do you feel like it’s **getting worse quickly** (over hours) or **staying about the same / slowly worsening** (over days)?
I don’t know.

Okay.

**Question 3:** Are you currently able to speak in **full sentences**, or are you **too short of breath to speak full sentences**?
I don’t know.

Understood.

**Question 4:** Have you had **chest pain or pressure** along with the shortness of breath? (Yes/No)
I don’t know.

Okay.

**Question 5:** Do you have **any fever or chills** recently? (Yes/No)
I don’t know.

Thanks—let’s narrow by breathing pattern.

**Question 6:** Do you have **wheezing** (a whistling sound) when you breathe? (Yes/No)
I don't know.

No worries.

**Question 7:** Do you have a **cough**? If yes, is it **dry** or **with phlegm/sputum**?
I don’t know.

Got it.

**Question 8:** Have you noticed **swelling of your lips/tongue**, **hives/itching**, or **throat tightness**? (Yes/No)
I don’t know.
**Question 9:** Have you had **recent leg swelling or pain** (especially one-sided), or have you been **immobile/long travel/surgery** recently? (Yes/No)
I don’t know.

I understand—let’s focus on a couple of high-yield details.

**Question 10:** Do you have a history of **asthma or COPD**, or have you ever been told you have **lung disease**? (Yes/No)
I don't know.

Thanks. One more key discriminator.

**Question 11:** When you feel short of breath, is it worse when you **lie flat**, and do you wake up at night **gasping**? (Yes/No)
I don’t know.

I’m not able to narrow this down yet because the key symptom details are unknown. I need a few more discriminating facts.

**Question 12:** Do you have a **new or worsening cough with fever**, or have you been around someone sick recently? (Yes/No)
I don’t know.

I’m going to pause because you’re unable to answer most of the discriminating questions, so I can’t confidently narrow to a specific diagnosis.
